meta.source: MTA OD estimates 2021–2024; all 48 validated monthly partitions.

network.meaning: Static reference network: GTFS consecutive stops and explicit transfers, not historical service availability or observed passenger paths.

meta.method: Calendar-weighted mean for each weekday/hour, denominator includes every occurrence in all twelve months. Static GTFS distance-shortest-path assignment; no historical service claim.
meta.sparse_assumption: An absent OD cell inside a complete published month contributes zero. Missing months are rejected.

raeb.dtype: little-endian Float32, dense origin-major square matrix; includes self OD without a rendered route
